messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a sustained bump in error rate for /v1/generate over the last ~20m. Can someone point me to the canonical dashboards and quick triage steps?

maya: thanks for flagging. start with the 'API Errors by Route' panel on Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/api-errors?from=now-1h&to=now — it breaks 4xx/5xx and shows top routes. also check 'Gateway Timeouts' panel for 504 trends.

ravi: quick checks:
- look at the PromQL: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (code)` to see code buckets.
- traces: open Tempo traces filtered by trace tag `route=/v1/generate` and status >= 500.
- logs: query in Loki: `{app="api"} | json | route=="/v1/generate" | status>=500`

sasha: if it's a 4xx spike, confirm if downstream clients changed or a bad release. 5xx tends to be overload or model timeout. is the increase mostly 429/504/502?

alex: it's a mix — mostly 429s and a few 502s. 429s look like bursty rate-limiting from a handful of IPs. 502s correlate with p99 latency increases on the model pool.

maya: for 429 noise, you can reduce alert noise by switching the alert to a rate threshold over a longer window. example (Datadog-style pseudorule):
```
alert: High 429s for /v1/generate
expr: sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status="429"}[10m])) > 100
for: 15m
```
Change `10m`->`30m` or bump `for:` to 30m to avoid short bursts.

ravi: for the 502s, check model-worker queue length and model latency histogram. Grafana panels: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/model-pool/model-latency and https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/model-pool/queue-depth. Correlate with infra autoscale events.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2028. Assigned to @sasha. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2028

sasha: i'll take the 502 side. quick plan:
1) pull sample traces where parent span shows `model.call` duration > 5000ms.
2) check pod CPU + GPU utilization around those timestamps.
3) if model pool saturated, increase burst nodes for dedicated capacity or route to a lower-latency model variant (we have `gpt-small:quant` as fallback).

alex: thx. for routing, where's the policy config? i remember a routing table in the console.

maya: routing policy is in Console -> Deployments -> Routes -> Fallbacks. for infra CLI quick override you can use: `rwctl route set-fallback /v1/generate --model gpt-small:quant` (requires perms).

ravi: also consider prefix KV cache for repeated prompts to cut token work. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/cache/prefix-hitrate

alex: one more ask — can we get a short checklist we can paste into the incident ticket for on-call? i can file a low-priority postmortem if needed.

sasha: paste this into INC-2028: 
- timeline of error-rate spike (dashboard link)
- top source IPs/user agents for 429s (logs query)
- sample traces for 502s (trace IDs)
- model-pool metrics (latency, queue depth, GPU util)
- action taken (routing fallback / increased capacity / alert tuning)

maya: and add the alert tuning change we made: moved 429 alert to 30m window and set a mute for the next 2 hours while we stabilize.

alex: awesome — i'll update INC-2028 with screenshots and the Loki queries. if anything else comes up ping me. :thumbsup:

ravi: FYI, putting a short note in the runbook: `if 502s increase and queue depth > 80% for 5m, escalate to model infra and consider fallback`.

oncall-bot: INC-2028 updated: status=investigating, assignee=sasha, priority=high

sasha: done some triage — traces show a spike in model `init` times around the same window, likely cold starts after an autoscaler event. i'll keep digging and post findings here.

alex: thanks all — super helpful. we'll follow up with a short postmortem if we confirm autoscaling/cold-start root cause.
